regime_context: As of 2026-07-20, China A-shares detector shows AI Compute & Optics as the dominant leader (rank 1, score 1.91, trend), with Semiconductors as a close challenger (rank 2, score 1.65). Rotation breadth is narrowing (6 of 22 eligible themes). The absolute-trend gate has not reduced drawdown historically in this market (gate_helps: false), so any trend-following allocation is experimental. Pharma is crowded (z=1.38) but trending and by rule should not be faded, only capped.
emerging_watch: Consumer Electronics (cn_consumer_elec, rank 4, score 0.42) is an early-stage narrative that may be forming, per the Narrative Scout. It is trending, uncrowded (z -0.58), but breadth is narrow (0.2). Watch for rank staying in top 5, breadth expanding above 0.3, and score increasing over the next 2–3 weeks. Kill criterion: if rank falls below 7 by 2026-08-03 OR breadth remains ≤0.2 and score turns negative, abandon the hypothesis. Any sudden ETF inflow spike while rank stagnates would also kill the formation thesis.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute remains the highest-ranked theme with a durable trend (durability 0.58, hurst trend, uncrowded). The crowding-skeptic has no objection (crowded false, z -0.45), and the rotation leader status supports the lean, but the gate's unhelpfulness and past misses (track record 0/2) anchor conviction to low.
evidence: Rotation leader: rank 1, score 1.915, durability bar 0.58 (detector state ranks[0]).
Uncrowded status (crowding_z -0.45, crowded false) clears the crowding-skeptic's hurdle.
Hurst tag 'trend' and breadth 0.235 confirm trend-following structure.
theses.dissent: The absolute-trend gate did_NOT_hold_here in backtests, making this lean experimental and prone to whipsaws. The detector’s own track record (2 misses, 0 hits) reduces confidence further.

falsifier.text: AI Compute & Optics falls below rank 3 AND its 10-day score turns negative within 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors is the strongest challenger (rank 2, score 1.65), also trending (durability 0.63, hurst trend) and uncrowded. The margin to the leader is modest (0.265), so it could benefit if the leader stalls, but no handoff is confirmed. The crowding-skeptic raises no issue (crowded false).
evidence: Rotation challenger rank 2, score 1.65, durability 0.63 (detector state ranks[1]).
Uncrowded (crowding_z 0.3, crowded false) – no crowding-skeptic objection.
Trend persistence (hurst trend) and positive score support a cautious overweight.
theses.dissent: Same gate_helps false issue; trend-following here lacks historical drawdown protection. Very low breadth (0.182) suggests a narrow rally that could reverse quickly if the leader weakens.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors falls below rank 4 OR its 14-day relative strength vs CSI 300 turns negative within 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Despite a crowded flag (z=1.38, crowded true), the guardrails explicitly forbid fading the theme, only down-sizing. It remains rank 3 with high durability (0.91) and complete breadth (1.0), so a cautious overweight is permitted. The crowding-skeptic would naturally argue for a cap, which we embed as dissent, not a fade.
evidence: Rank 3, score 0.87, durability 0.91, hurst trend, breadth 1.0 (detector state ranks[2]).
Crowded flag (crowded true) triggers the crowding-skeptic's caution, but the rule is cap, not exit.
theses.dissent: Crowding-skeptic objection: crowding_z 1.38 flags concentrated positioning and a history of mean-reversion when attention reverses. The theme’s high breadth suggests broad participation, but the crowding signal itself is a clear size-down warning, amplified by the gate’s unproven edge.

falsifier.text: Innovative Pharma & CXO's rank drops below 5 OR its 20-day average score turns negative within 15 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
